target.title: fix(feishu): skip malformed forwarded message items
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users receiving Feishu merged-forwarded messages could lose the expandable forwarded-message context when the Feishu API returned a mixed `items` array containing malformed non-message entries.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Feishu merge_forward parser now narrows the API `items` payload before reading sub-message fields, skipping null, primitive, and nested-array entries while preserving valid sub-messages. This stays inside the Feishu bot content parser used by `handleFeishuMessage`, and does not change config, provider behavior, message routing, or valid forwarded-message ordering.

## User Impact

Feishu users can still get valid forwarded sub-message text in agent context even when one API item is malformed.

## Evidence

- Claim proved by current-head code proof: Feishu merge_forward parsing skips malformed API items and keeps valid sub-messages in the same payload.
- Current head: `f11480ffa1def8c65439d10d0c4ef5e0a74cbfac`.
- Focused regression: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/bot.test.ts -t "merge_forward"` passed in `openclaw-lane-k` with 1 file passing and 4 tests passing.
- Diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Diff scope: `git diff --name-only upstream/main...HEAD` shows only `extensions/feishu/src/bot-content.ts` and `extensions/feishu/src/bot.test.ts`.
- Observed result: the focused regression covers null, primitive, and array entries from the merge_forward API items list and verifies the valid text sub-message still renders as `[Merged and Forwarded Messages]\n- valid`.
- Proof gap: live Feishu/Lark behavior proof is not available from this contributor environment. Clearing the ClawSweeper real-behavior ask still needs redacted output from a real Feishu/Lark setup showing a mixed `im.message.get` `data.items` response and the preserved valid child text after this patch.
